programs.description: Ashok and Kumar are best friends who live with Maamaji. Chaos ensues when Maamaji comes up with a series of plans to take Ashok's wealth that accidentally expose them to two sets of lookalikes.
Yash and Raj, childhood friends and petty thieves, rob a bank, causing the innocent manager to be blamed. To prove his innocence, the manager devises a plan to apprehend the culprits.
Despite facing a loss in the 1952 Summer Olympics, Coach Rahim builds a formidable football team and strives to bring glory to India.
A musician must compose 100 songs in order to reunite with his lover. However, his journey of heartbreak, redemption, loss and faith allows him to discover much more than love.
After their Sunday game is cancelled, five friends look for their own place to play football in the crowded city of Mumbai.
Three friends form a fake extortion gang to quell their financial problems. However, the secretive company gains fame overnight and finds itself getting entrusted by numerous callers.
Lord Mountbatten, the last Viceroy of India, is tasked with overseeing the transition to Independence; however, he faces numerous challenges as the country undergoes a monumental change: Partition.
Inspector Mauli, a cowardly policeman, shares his name with his twin brother who has a starkly different personality. When the two move to a lawless village, things take a chaotic and dangerous turn.
Karan and Rhea meet on a flight and end up hating each other at the end of their journey. Things change between them when they continue to bump into each other at different stages of their lives.
After a series of career and relationship downturns, Kaira begins suffering from insomnia. She contacts Dr Jehangir Khan, a psychologist, who uses unconventional methods to treat her.

programs.showName: Once Upon a Time in Mumbai Dobaara
programs.description: Shoaib becomes the new mafia leader after killing his mentor, Sultan Mirza. He later finds a protégé in Aslam, but trouble ensues when they both fall in love with the same woman, Jasmine.

A Rajasthani father goes to extreme lengths to help a daughter pursue higher studies in London. Along the way, misadventures and misunderstandings put their relationship through its paces.
Preity and Vishal, two incompatible collegians, impersonating their friends on social media, find love as they work together.
After learning the truth behind the brutal massacre at the Jallianwala Bagh, C Sankaran Nair, a member of the Viceroy's Council, sets out to challenge the Crown and the military general responsible.
While struggling to survive, Manny and Kizie, who each have a terminal illness, fall in love with each other. Thereafter, the two try to spend the rest of their days being happy and staying positive.
Interspersed with life-altering revelations and breathtaking sceneries, an unexpected road trip becomes a turning point in the relationship of a father-son duo.
A whacky situation arises when a bunch of first-time hijackers try to take over a plane but accidentally get high along with the passengers.
A wealthy Raj Singhania begins an affair with Priya, an entertainer who already has a boyfriend. While they start their relationship, Priya's lover decides to get his revenge on them.

Four reluctant orphans fall under the care of an industrialist who accidentally killed their parents. As the dejected children hate him and cause trouble, God sends an angel to help make things right.
A woman's life takes a turn after she is hired to be the mascot of the Indian cricket team. However, she is later forced to choose between her boyfriend and her new career.
A girl from Ambala, Kavya Pratap Singh, is about to get married to an NRI. When she visits Delhi to shop for her trousseau, she meets Humpty Sharma, a carefree man, and falls in love with him.
A game of cat and mouse ensues when four unique people from different backgrounds leave on a fateful journey to find a suitcase containing INR 25 crores, which has been stolen from a gangster.

In Jhansi, Badri's traditional, patriarchal upbringing by his dominant father has shaped him into a chauvinist. He seeks the ideal bride in Vaidehi, an ambitious girl from Kota. Unlike Badri, Vaidehi fights to escape male dominance, craving the independence and identity rarely afforded to small-town Indian women. Their meeting sets off a clash between tradition and aspiration.
Madhumita and Vishwanathan fall in love with each other but his father disapproves of the relationship as he wants his twin sons to marry two identical twins.
Vijju, a feared ex-convict, is hired to kill ACP Karan Malhotra. However, rekindled love and haunting memories of his estranged wife lead him to defy his violent destiny.
Two meddling friends Bantu and Chantu join a hotel management programme in Goa by pretending to be the owner's nephew and his friend. While training, they expose many employees and guests as frauds.
Dharampal, a 55-year-old man, discovers that he was born Muslim and was adopted by his Hindu family. His life is thrown into upheaval as he does not know which religion to follow.
Aryan is in a live-in relationship with his partner, Anaya, in London. However, problems arise when Gangasharan and Guddi, their uncle and aunt from India, come to their house uninvited.
Veer and Geet fall in love and decide to marry but Veer messes up his first impression on Geet's father, causing further obstacles.
Upon losing his job, a man decides to break free from societal pressures and become an entrepreneur with his friends. However, his new venture comes with a new set of problems.

programs.showName: Rocket Singh: Salesman of the Year
programs.description: Harpreet Singh Bedi, a commerce graduate, becomes a salesman. After being ridiculed by his colleagues and his employer, he plans to operate a parallel company without their knowledge.
Veera, a young bride-to-be, is abducted by a local gangster, Mahabir, and his men a day prior to her wedding. Far from being terrified of her abductor, Veera discovers a new meaning to her life.

A sighted pianist, feigning blindness, faces myriad complications after inadvertently witnessing an ex-film star's murder.
Aman, a Pakistani man, falls for Asha, an Indian woman, and wishes to marry her. So, he attempts to impress her family, but chaos erupts when his nationality is revealed.
Prem, a school dropout, hesitantly marries an educated but overweight girl, Sandhya. However, the two come closer when they take part in a race, which involves Prem carrying Sandhya on his back.
After her son's unexpected death, a sorrowful mother heads to Kolkata, only to find herself grappling with the complexities of his undisclosed past.
Meera, an attractive single mother of Indian origin living in Australia, faces the wrath of her family after she falls in love with an Australian man.
The life of Nambi Narayanan is full of struggles and accomplishments as an aerospace engineer. However, he faces his biggest challenge while working at ISRO when the world accuses him of treason.
In 1971, Ghazi, a submarine from Pakistan, tries to destroy the port at Vizag but, S21, an Indian submarine, poses as an obstacle.
The lives of a wealthy man and a poor man intersect one fateful night. This unforeseen event ends up changing things drastically for them and their families.
Saloni, a young woman, discovers that she has been impregnated by two men, Akhil and Gurbir. Chaos ensues as the two men compete for Saloni's heart.
Despite heavy opposition from their parents, Aditya and Suhani run away and get married. However, cracks soon begin to develop in their fairy-tale romance.
A charming diamond thief and his unwitting sidekick embark on a rollercoaster of romance, espionage, and explosive transcontinental battles, proving that love can indeed conquer all.

Nakul, a 25-year-old man, is shocked to discover that his mother is pregnant. His struggle to come to terms with the news puts his relationship with his girlfriend in jeopardy.
Vinod, a railway engineer, launches the Super Express, a dream project that is India's fastest passenger train. However, it goes out of control on its maiden journey due to a bomb planted by a rival.
Jass, a lawyer's son, is in love with Meet, but the proposal is rejected by his father. However, he strives to win his lover's hand and devises a plan.

After completion of her examinations, Mumbai-based Rhea Dialdas, who lives with her parents; younger sister, Minty; and paternal grandmother, looks forward to spending more time with hunky Luv Nanda, the son of Mukesh - rumored to be a smuggler.
A struggling actor tries to prove his mettle but fails repeatedly. His life changes when he meets Tina who encourages him to participate in a nationwide talent hunt.
Sriram, a self-centred man, lies to his girlfriend, Dia, for his selfish gain. However, later, Sriram realises his mistake and has to fulfil a condition laid down by Dia to win her back.
When a young journalist questions the immoral behaviour of a revered religious leader in his article, the latter files a case against him in court.
Manu, an NRI doctor, comes to India in search of a bride and falls in love with Tanu. Poles apart from her suitor, Tanu, a fun-loving girl, rather enlists his help in eloping with her lover.
After John Day and Maria lose their daughter in an accidental forest fire, it affects the mental health of Maria. Later, a courier person enters their home and abducts her.

Raj, a veterinarian from Mumbai, returns to his father's elephant reserve. There, he learns of a poaching operation being conducted and sets out to thwart them.
Aditya is trying to recover from his wife's betrayal and his physical disability. Meanwhile, Indrajeet Singh, a prince whose property was confiscated by Aditya's family, returns to exact revenge.
Veer and Geet fall in love and decide to marry but Veer messes up his first impression on Geet's father, causing further obstacles.
Ved Vyas Tripathi, a devout Hindu, is confronted with an identity crisis and an intellectual conflict when he learns he is actually a Muslim by birth.
Freddy, a shy dentist, falls for Kainaaz and agrees to help her kill her abusive husband. However, upon discovering that her plan all along was to use him, Freddy sets out to seek revenge.
Dhruv, who grew up an orphan, is in love with a woman who wishes to marry someone with a family. In order to fulfil his lover's wish, he hires two older individuals to pose as his parents.
Brothers, Vibhooti and Chiraunji, run an exorcism business and take advantage of people's superstition. However, things take a horrifying turn when they accept a case from Maya.
Tara, a woman from lower caste, aims at bringing a change in her community. So, she faces several challenges and eventually becomes the chief minister of Uttar Pradesh.
The retired con couple Bunty and Babli are forced to rejoin the business to thwart the attempts of a young duo that robs people with their trademark sigil and bring them to justice.
Indoo's one-night stand plans hit a snag after she discovers her charming partner's nationality and starts suspecting him of being a wanted terrorist.
Squadron Leader Vijay Karnik of the IAF races to conclude his task and shape history with the aid of 300 women during the 1971 Indo-Pakistani conflict.
